title: Satsari Asam Buranji: Seven Classical Chronicles of Assam and Tai Kingdoms
title_as: সাতসৰী অসম বুৰঞ্জী: সাতখন প্ৰাচীন বুৰঞ্জীৰ সংকলন (ড° সূৰ্য্য কুমাৰ ভূঞা, ১৯৬০)
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan (Editor)
genre: Compendium of Classical Buranjis / Archival Sanchi Manuscripts
description: Authoritative compendium of seven distinct historical Buranjis edited by Dr. S.K. Bhuyan. Contains multiple primary citations detailing royal embassies between the Nora / Khamyang princes and the Ahom administration, boundary agreements on the Namrup and Dikhau rivers, and clan settlements.

units.translation_en: The sovereign kings of Assam regularly dispatched royal letters and emissaries to the King of the Nora.
units.translation_as: আহোম স্বৰ্গদেউসকলে নিয়মীয়াকৈ নৰা ৰজালৈ মৈত্ৰীৰ ৰাজকীয় পত্ৰ প্ৰেৰণ কৰিছিল।
